slug: 诸天之百味人生第一千六百二十章

第22章股神
回到刘北山的家，华十二并没有睡觉休息，而是坐在沙发上喝着啤酒等着德甲那三场比赛的结果。
虽然做为一个穿越的前知者，他知道最后的准确比分，但涉及几千万的奖金，在尘埃落定之前，他也难以做到心如止水。
可是这货喝着喝着，就觉得眼皮发沉，再睁眼的时候，暖洋洋的晨曦从窗户照射进来，竟然已经是第二天早上了。
华十二赶紧拿出手机，查看比赛结果，‘弗赖堡’3比2战胜‘霍芬海姆’，‘门兴格拉德巴赫’5比1大胜‘科隆’。
狠狠地挥了一下手，前两场比赛全中！
现在离千万富翁就只差今天晚上最后一场斯图加特vs凯泽斯劳滕的比赛了。
华十二起身洗漱，然后给自己热了一袋牛奶，煮了个鸡蛋当作早餐，吃完之后骑车出门。
上午九点三十，华十二准时踏进了股票交易大厅，一同来的还有心怀忐忑，跟着他来查看结果的赖子和大康。
当两人看到爆赚百分之十五的时候，都不由自主发出欢呼之声，惹得周围的股民一阵侧目。
华十二笑着调侃道：“看看你们这没见过世面的样子，这才哪到哪儿啊，咱们以后天天都有的赚！”
说完他操作交易所的电脑，选择将持有的股票全部卖出，百分之十五的收益也随之落袋为安。
“小北哥，你怎么就卖了啊，这不是还涨着呢么！”
赖子见那支股票还是红色的，他知道这是上涨的意思，所以见华十二卖掉股票，顿时急了。
大康性格相对沉稳，斥道：“你懂股票还是我懂股票啊？咱俩都不懂，这事儿就都听北哥的！”
赖子解释道：“我看这不是还涨呢么，就觉得可惜！”
华十二笑着摇摇头，懒得解释，这支股票肯定还有的涨，但具体的他确并没有记忆，这证明这股票第二日的行情，不在他提前收集的信息之中，也就是说，这股票今天并没有涨停板，那还有什么意思。
他输入一个股票代码，顿时显现出一支绿色的股票来，这是一支以跌停板开盘的股票。
股票涨停的时候，能卖出去但难买到，跌停的时候，能买到但卖不出去，所以华十二选择的这支跌停板的股票并不影响买卖，他当即全仓买入。
看到华十二买了一支跌停板的股票，赖子顿时又急了：“北哥你放着涨的股票不买，怎么买跌停的啊？”

大康捶了赖子肩膀一下：“都说听北哥的了，你老添什么乱！”
“不是，我这不是替北哥担心么！”
“行了，你们等着看结果就是了！”
华十二让那个金融系大学生为他收集的资料里，每天一个股票代码，都代表着是当天涨停的股票，而2011年4月10日的股票代码，绝对就是这个，他肯定没记错。
也就是说，这只股票虽然眼下是跌停，但收盘的时候，一定是涨停。
这就厉害了，他跌停买入，等到涨停的时候，一天就有20%的盈利，这简直比抢钱来的还快。
果然他的判断没有错，就在华十二刚买完不久，还没有退出操作系统的时候，他买的那支跌停板的股票，已经打开了跌停，肉眼可见的朝上反弹。
“涨了，涨了，真的涨了！”
看着转眼之间就反弹了3%，赖子兴奋的抱着华十二就要来一口，却被后者一把推开。
赖子揉着胸口抱怨道：“我靠，小北哥，你哪来的这么大力气！”
大康拍了拍赖子的肩膀笑道：“是你太弱鸡啦！”
“走，吃饭去！”
中午收盘之前，华十二买的那支股票就已经涨停，短短半日就爆赚了20%，账面上又多了四千多大洋，如果不出意外，战果将会保持到下午收盘，等到明天卖出落袋为安。
别以为每天一个涨停板转不了多少钱，咱不说今天这种20%的，就说每天正常10%的盈利率来说，网上有人专门统计过，1万炒到100万元，要四十七个涨停板，也就是1万x（1+10%）的47次方=106万。

Chapter 22 Stock God
Back at Liu Beishan's home, Hua Twelve did not sleep, but sat on the sofa drinking beer and waiting for the results of the three Bundesliga games.
Although as a time traveler, he knew the final accurate score, but with tens of millions of bonuses involved, it was difficult for him to calm down until the dust settled.
But as he drank, his eyelids felt heavy. When he opened his eyes again, the warm morning light shone in through the window, and it turned out to be the next morning.
Hua Twelve quickly took out his mobile phone and checked the game results. Freiburg beat Hoffenheim 3-2, and Monchengladbach beat Cologne 5-1.
He waved his hand hard and scored in the first two games!
Now the only thing left to become a multi-millionaire is tonight's last game between Stuttgart and Kaiserslautern.
Hua Twelve got up and washed up, then heated himself a bag of milk, boiled an egg for breakfast, and went out on his bike after eating.
At 9:30 in the morning, Hua Twelve stepped into the stock trading hall on time, accompanied by Lai Zi and Dakang, who were anxious and followed him to check the results.
When the two of them saw the huge profit of 15%, they couldn't help but cheer, causing the surrounding investors to look askance.
Hua Twelve laughed and joked: "Look at you who have never seen the world, where are you? We will make money every day from now on!"
After speaking, he operated the exchange's computer and chose to sell all the stocks he held, and he pocketed 15% of the profits.
"Brother Xiao Bei, why did you sell it? It's still going up!"
Lai Zi saw that the stock was still red, and he knew it meant rising, so when he saw Hua Twelve selling the stock, he became anxious.
Dakang has a relatively calm personality and scolded: "Do you know stocks or do I know stocks? Neither of us understands, so we just have to listen to Brother Bei on this matter!"
Lai Zi explained: "I think it's still going up, so I feel it's a pity!"
Hua Twelve smiled and shook his head, too lazy to explain that the stock must still rise, but he did not remember the details. This proved that the stock's market price on the second day was not among the information he collected in advance. In other words, the stock did not have a daily limit today, so what's the point.
He entered a stock code, and a green stock immediately appeared. This was a stock that opened at the lower limit.
When the stock reaches its daily limit, it can be sold but difficult to buy. When it drops to its limit, it can be bought but cannot be sold. Therefore, the stock that Hua Twelve chose with its lower limit does not affect his trading. He immediately bought the entire position.
Seeing that Hua Twelve bought a stock that fell to the limit, Lai Zi suddenly became anxious again: "Brother Bei, if you don't buy the rising stock, how can you buy the stock that fell to the limit?"
Dakang slapped Lai Zi on the shoulder: "I told you to listen to Brother Bei, why are you always causing trouble!"
"No, aren't I worried about Brother Bei?"
"Okay, just wait and see the results!"
Among the information that Hua Twelve asked the finance college student to collect for him, a stock code every day represented the stock that hit the daily limit that day, and the stock code on April 10, 2011 was definitely this one. He must have remembered it correctly.
In other words, although this stock is currently at its lower limit, it will definitely be at its upper limit when the market closes.
This is amazing, he buys at the lower limit, and when the upper limit is reached, he will make a 20% profit in one day, which is faster than grabbing money.
Sure enough, his judgment was correct. Shortly after buying Hua Twelve and before exiting the operating system, the stock he bought that had dropped to its limit had already opened its limit and was rebounding upwards visible to the naked eye.
"It's gone up, it's gone up, it's really gone up!"
Seeing that the price had rebounded by 3% in the blink of an eye, Lai Zi excitedly hugged Hua Twelve and was about to take a bite, but was pushed away by the latter.
Laizi rubbed his chest and complained: "Damn it, Brother Xiaobei,Where did you get such strength! "
Dakang patted Lai Zi on the shoulder and said with a smile: "You are too weak! "
"Let's go eat! "
Before the market closed at noon, the stock that Hua Twelve bought had already reached its daily limit. In just half a day, it made a huge profit of 20%, adding another four thousand yuan to its account. If nothing unexpected happened, the results would be maintained until the market closed in the afternoon, and it would be safe to sell it tomorrow.
Don't think that a daily limit can't make much money. Let's not talk about today's 20%, just a normal daily profit rate of 10%. Someone on the Internet has specially calculated that to speculate from 10,000 yuan to 1 million yuan, 47 daily limit boards are needed, that is, 10,000 x (1+10%) to the 47th power = 1.06 million.
